## testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: Replay tests for the 7 sub-cases of the decision tree calibration matrix (epic SC3 a-g) all pass — fire/suppress verdicts match design intent.

## What to Do
Create `tests/brainstorm/test-decision-tree-calibration.sh` (chmod +x) with function `test_decision_tree_7_subcases`.

The test should document the 7 sub-cases from SC3:
- (a) Confirmed external input → no re-entry
- (b) Inferred input (hedging trigger) → re-entry
- (c) Inferred input (confident assertion trigger) → re-entry
- (d) Verified input (Read/Grep confirms) → suppress fire
- (e) Unverifiable input (timeout) → fire as not-verifiable
- (f) No external inputs → "no external inputs" bullet
- (g) Mixed inputs (some inferred, some confirmed) → partial re-entry

Fail with "run_brainstorm_replay not implemented" since LLM infrastructure is absent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/brainstorm/test-decision-tree-calibration.sh
- [ ] test_decision_tree_7_subcases function present
  Verify: grep -q "test_decision_tree_7_subcases" tests/brainstorm/test-decision-tree-calibration.sh
- [ ] Test FAILS RED
  Verify: bash tests/brainstorm/test-decision-tree-calibration.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] RED marker in .test-index
  Verify: grep "test_decision_tree_7_subcases" .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
